test_title: PYST 24: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, I, J, K, L, O, P and Q are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit to the right of I. Only two people sit between I and O. Only two people sit between J and P. P sits to the immediate left of I. Q sits to the immediate right of L. Who sits at third position from the left end of the line?
solution:
Given: Seven people, I, J, K, L, O, P and Q are sitting in a row, facing north.

1) Only two people sit to the right of I.

2) Only two people sit between I and O. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d68d7035f27e970f8bbdf34b9526dc8e8049166530d172b6d0efb0e44c88939d.png] 

3) Only two people sit between J and P.

4) P sits to the immediate left of I. 

5) Q sits to the immediate right of L. 

After positioning J, P, Q and L only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bc9df90902740a7d629bcff6582f3b141930e648af0aa2738c4b9c090349f91.png] 

Thus, K sits at third position from the left end of the line.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
